text.tspan: Dashboard forense. SPA con SSR.\nConsuye API REST via TanStack Query.\nPuerto :3000 / :3100 prod.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan:
Recibe HTTP en :8080.
Proxy FastCGI a pool PHP.
Rate limit 2 req/s en /audit.*
Templates con envsubst.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan:
Bootstrap en public/index.php.
11 Controladores REST.
25 Endpoints definidos en web.php.
Rate limit APCu + fallback archivos.
5 réplicas en producción.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan:
3 Streams: audit.inbox, audit.documents, audit.results
+ audit.dlq para dead letters.
State store para auditorías en curso (TTL 24h).
Circuit breaker Gemini (keys cb:gemini:*).
Cache de extracción por document_hash.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan:
Consume: audit.inbox (group: orchestrator).
Resuelve FDV + audit-config + adjuntos.
Construye extraction_contract.
Publica N x document_registered.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan:
Consume: audit.documents (group: extractors).
Descarga adjunto (Drive URL o BLOB).
sha256(file) → cache Redis.
Llama Gemini FC (parallel function calling).
Publica document_extracted.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan:
Consume: audit.documents (group: normalizers).
Fechas ISO, uppercase sin tildes,
núméricos canónicos, null para vacío.
Publica document_normalized.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan:
Consume: audit.documents (group: policy).
Evalúa COINCIDE / VALOR_DISTINTO /
NO_ENCONTRADO / OMITIDO / NO_CONCLUYENTE.
SemanticMatchJudge para homologación.
Publica rules_evaluated cuando docs_done == docs_total.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan:
Consume: audit.results (group: aggregator).
AuditResultData + documentDecisions.
MERGE AudDispEst + UPDATE AdjuntosDispensacionDetalle.
Publica audit_completed | audit_failed.

text.style: text-anchor: middle; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text-anchor: middle; font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-family: "Open Sans", sans-serif;
text.tspan:
Webhook autenticado por X-API-KEY.
4 herramientas: GetClients, GetInvoices,
GetDispensation, GetAttachments.
Usa ApiClient interno.
